highlights: Dimensions    44.5mm x 39.4mm x 9.9mm   *Height, width and thickness dimensions exclude the strap and protrusions    26g (without inbox strap)
Sensors   Heart rate sensor (with blood oxygen sensor) | Accelerometer
Light usage: 18 days*Test conditions for the 18-day light usage scenario: Fully charge the watch and restore it to factory settings.

Set brightness to 120nits. Use the default watch face, disable advanced sleep monitoring, all-day stress monitoring and all-day blood oxygen monitoring, and enable message notifications and all-day heart rate monitoring every 10 minutes.

Under these settings, the watch receives 100 messages and 2 incoming calls per day, with 3 alarms, 200 raise-to-wake activations and 1 app sync, plus 15 minutes of Bluetooth calling and 90 minutes of exercise recording with GNSS enabled per week.
Normal usage: 12 days*Test conditions for the 12-day normal usage scenario: Fully charge the watch and restore it to factory settings. Set brightness to 120nits.
Use the default watch face, enable advanced sleep monitoring, all-day stress monitoring, all-day blood oxygen monitoring and smart heart rate monitoring, and enable message notifications.

Under these settings, the watch receives 100 messages and 2 incoming calls per day, with 3 alarms, 360 raise-to-wake activations, 1 app sync and 6 minutes of screen interaction per day, plus 15 minutes of Bluetooth calling and 180 minutes of exercise recording with GNSS enabled per week.

Heavy usage: 6 days*Test conditions for the 6-day heavy usage scenario: Fully charge the watch and restore it to factory settings. Set brightness to 120nits. Use the default AOD watch face, enable advanced sleep monitoring, all-day stress monitoring, all-day blood oxygen monitoring and smart heart rate monitoring, and enable message notifications.
